text:
sarah: From the INC-3245 postmortem: we saw an eviction-ripple during rapid scale-ups. Need a short playbook fragment (detect, triage commands, immediate mitigations) + clear owners and deadlines. I sketched below.

dan: I will own the playbook PR and paste exact commands.

mike: I'll own the PD escalation text and test the alert thresholds.

sarah: Minimal detect + triage to paste verbatim into runbook: 
1) check recent eviction events: kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector reason=Evicted --since=30m
2) collect pod logs (focus on cache pods): kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --tail=300 | egrep -i "evict|OOM|killed"
3) snapshot eviction metric: redwood-metrics query "increase(redis_evictions[5m])"
4) pod resource state: kubectl top pods -n infra --containers
5) autoscaler trace: kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=1h | egrep -i "scale|failed to"

mike: Immediate mitigation suggestions to include: scale cache replicas by +2, apply temporary pod anti-affinity, and if urgent cordon the node showing highest memory pressure. Add note: if mitigation used, record autoscaler commit hash and evidence path.

incidents-bot: ACTION-8112 created: owner=dan due=2378907200

dan: ACTION-8112: open PR docs/runbooks/eviction-ripple.md with the above checklist and the mitigation steps. Will include ACTION id and link to INC-3245 in PR body. Target: EOD today.

mike: ACTION-8113 created: owner=mike due=2378908000. I'll post PD JSON and verify in staging.

oncall: Acknowledged. When paged I'll run the five steps, tar artifacts to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/, and paste links here.

sarah: We'll have a 15m check-in Wed to confirm PR merged and PD rules deployed. If owners need more time, flag here before EOD.

incidents-bot: ACTION-8112 status: in_progress (owner: dan); ACTION-8113 status: open (owner: mike).
